encoder_audio_gain_db.description: Per-stream gain applied by the final Encoder. This value may be updated while the stream is live without restarting FFmpeg.

overlay_profile_id.description: Selected watermark profile. Empty disables the watermark; changing this value updates the live Encoder overlay without restarting FFmpeg.

base_path.description: Ignored legacy value. folder_id is the archive root.

client_id.description: OAuth client ID for Encoder/Recorder token refresh.

client_secret_secret_name.description: Runtime secret reference for the OAuth client secret.

folder_id_secret_name.description: Runtime secret reference resolved by the assigned Encoder/Recorder through Control Panel.

refresh_token_secret_name.description: Runtime secret reference for the OAuth refresh token.

archive_run_id.description: Stable identifier for one broadcast/archive run. Legacy callers omit this field.

started_at.description: Archive run start time. Required when archive_run_id is present.

stream_key.description: Deprecated backward-compatible raw runtime secret. Production Control Panel-managed YouTube outputs, including live_api_dry_run, must send stream_key_secret_name instead.

stream_key_secret_name.description: Runtime secret reference resolved by the assigned Encoder/Recorder through the Control Panel. This is preferred for stored YouTube outputs and YouTube Live API short-lived stream keys.

video_cover_start.description: Desired Video Cover start snapshot. New Control Panel producers send this snapshot for both active and inactive desired state so Encoder can bind the visual epoch before GET/reconcile. Whole-field omission remains accepted only for legacy callers during compatibility.

worker_video_ingest.description: Internal opt-in requesting a per-job SRT listener for the assigned Worker scene video. Existing callers omit this field.

worker_video_ingest_token.description: Short-lived job-scoped token authorizing the Worker video ingest allocation. It is internal request data and must never appear in logs, audit metadata, process status, or public API responses.

youtube_runtime.description: Non-secret YouTube lifecycle metadata prepared by Control Panel. A canonical public YouTube watch URL may be included for a prepared live_api_relay_static runtime; raw stream keys and OAuth tokens must not be included here.

encoder-start-stream-response.schema.description: Internal Encoder/Recorder start response. video_ingest is returned only to the Control Panel dispatcher and must be removed before audit, status, or public API serialization.

video_ingest.description: Internal service-to-service response data for the assigned Worker. Never copy this object into process status, dispatch results, audit metadata, or public Control Panel responses.

passphrase.description: Per-job SRT passphrase. It must be consumed only by the internal dispatcher and never serialized to any public response or log.

pbkeylen.description: SRT AES key length in bytes. Version 1 requires AES-256.

url.description: Secret-free SRT listener URL. Userinfo, query parameters, and fragments are prohibited.

encoder-start-stream-response.schema.title: EncoderStartStreamResponse

encoderVideoCoverApplyRequest.description: Strict Control Panel to Encoder Video Cover CAS. It can mutate only the Cover layer; Watermark fields are intentionally not representable. OpenAPI path id and body stream_id equality is enforced by the named behavioral validator because JSON Schema cannot express that relation.

expected_generation.description: CAS fence for the Encoder-owned graph instance generation currently observed by Control Panel.

hide_confirmed.description: Required for hide. An ambiguous hide outcome is reconciled by GET and is never automatically resent.

job_generation.description: Control Panel-owned stream visual start epoch.

encoderVideoCoverApplyResponse.description: Strict Encoder apply result. Applied=true is impossible without an actual runtime state carrying a graph-applied witness. Cross-field equality is enforced by the named behavioral validator because JSON Schema cannot express value equality between object locations.

actual_generation.description: Encoder-owned graph instance generation observed when producing this response.

mediaAssetDescriptor.description: Static PNG, JPEG, or WebP metadata only. SVG, GIF, animation, filesystem paths, URLs, and Base64 payloads are not representable.

pixel_count.description: The producer must verify this equals decoded width multiplied by height before declaring readiness.

revision.description: Immutable processed-variant revision. It is copied from media_asset_variants.processor_revision and never changes for an existing variant identity.

sha256.description: Public integrity digest only; never an authentication credential.

generation.description: Encoder-owned graph instance generation that applied this state.

graph_applied.description: True only after the Encoder graph has applied the Cover state. Acceptance or asset validation alone cannot produce this witness.

watermark.description: Independently observed Watermark layer; a Cover mutation cannot change it.

cover.description: Current Cover imagefeed layer state, independent from Watermark.

generation.description: Encoder-owned graph instance generation. It increases monotonically within one job_generation whenever a new graph instance becomes authoritative.

job_generation.description: Control Panel-owned stream visual start epoch shared with Scene Appearance generation.

no_automatic_resend.description: Unknown or ambiguous applied state requires an explicit operator resend with a new revision.

watermark.description: Current Watermark imagefeed layer state, independent from Cover.

videoCoverStartSnapshot.description: Desired Video Cover start snapshot. New Control Panel producers send it for both active and inactive desired state so Encoder binds job_generation and revision before GET/reconcile. active=true requires cover_asset; active=false forbids cover_asset. Whole-field omission remains only for legacy callers during compatibility.

job_generation.description: Control Panel-owned stream visual start epoch shared with Scene Appearance generation.

revision.description: Desired Video Cover revision captured for this start.

complete_last_error.description: Safe error code from the latest YouTube Live API complete failure. Raw OAuth or stream key material must not be included.

complete_next_retry_at.description: Next automatic YouTube Live API complete retry time, when a retained runtime is waiting for retry.

complete_on_stop.description: When true, Control Panel completes the YouTube Live broadcast during normal stream stop. Manual retry and cleanup may force completion.

complete_retry_count.description: Number of failed YouTube Live API complete attempts retained for automatic backoff retry.

relay_binding_id.description: Non-secret fixed relay binding identity for live_api_relay_static.

reusable_live_stream_id.description: Non-secret reusable YouTube LiveStream identity for live_api_relay_static. No ingestion address or stream key is present.

rtmp_url.description: Prepared RTMPS ingest URL for recovering an active YouTube Live API runtime. Stream key material must remain in stream_key_secret_name.

stream_key_secret_name.description: Short-lived runtime secret reference for YouTube Live API stream key. The raw key must not be included in this object.

watch_url.description: Canonical public watch URL. Live API modes derive it from broadcast_id; live_api_relay_static runtime may carry it. stream_key mode uses the configured output watch_url.

serviceToken.description: Node/service token supplied by Control Panel. It must never be embedded in a browser or VLC URL.

post.description: Internal Control Panel dispatch. When worker_video_ingest is true, the Encoder/Recorder allocates a job-scoped SRT listener for Worker JPEG scene frames and returns its connection material only in this internal service-to-service response. The dispatcher must remove video_ingest before writing status, audit metadata, logs, or any public Control Panel response.

202.description: stream start accepted; optional Worker scene-frame ingest is internal-only

400.description: invalid start payload or media configuration

409.description: stream already running or output relay state conflict

500.description: Encoder/Recorder could not allocate or start the stream

503.description: Worker video ingest is unavailable or could not allocate its encrypted SRT listener

get.description: Service-token-protected preview source for Control Panel. Encoder Recorder creates approximately two-second HLS segments and keeps the full active-stream playlist so an authorized preview can seek back to the beginning while the stream is running. Preview output is isolated from the primary live output and recording; preview backpressure or failure must not stop either primary output.

200.description: HLS playlist or complete MPEG-TS segment

Cache-Control.description: no-store for playlists; private, max-age=30 for segments

400.description: invalid stream path, asset name, symlink, or file identity

200.description: settings applied to the running Encoder process

400.description: invalid gain or watermark profile data

502.description: FFmpeg runtime command or watermark source update failed

put.summary: Change per-stream Encoder gain and watermark without restarting FFmpeg

get.description: Returns the Encoder-owned graph generation and graph-applied witness for the Control Panel-owned stream visual job epoch. Unknown or ambiguous applied state is returned explicitly and must not trigger an automatic resend.

200.description: current generation-fenced Video Cover runtime state

get.summary: Reconcile the actual Encoder Video Cover graph state

put.description: Mutates only the Cover imagefeed. The request cannot represent a Watermark mutation. Applied is returned only after the Encoder graph produced a graph-applied witness. Hide ambiguity is reconciled by GET and is never automatically resent. The path id and body stream_id must match exactly before the generation-fenced CAS is evaluated.

200.description: mutation applied or an exact idempotent result replayed

202.description: request accepted but the applied result is ambiguous; reconcile by GET without automatic resend

404.description: the running stream has no negotiated Video Cover runtime epoch; callers must not fabricate one from the rejected request

409.description: rejected stale job/generation/revision fence or idempotency conflict

502.description: video-local graph or asset failure; audio and the independent Watermark state remain active

put.summary: Apply one generation-fenced Video Cover mutation

get.description: Historical route name retained without introducing a /v2 URI prefix. This is an application-owned runtime identity probe consumed by the Local Executor during update verification; it is not Updater health. The current source has no explicit route-level no-store behavior. A later consumer implementation must emit the exact Cache-Control no-store response declared here.

503.description: Encoder Recorder runtime identity is unavailable; the response is safe and contains no raw configuration

get.summary: Read the Encoder Recorder application runtime identity
